structure. Keep every name, model, position number, article number, date and condition exactly. Do not add or
remove any detail. Return only the reworded question.
During the periodic verification of the P&H R200 mobile crane at position 17, must the employer show the results of a supplementary investigation?

response.text: Is the employer required to present the outcomes of a supplementary investigation when the P&H R200 mobile crane at position 17 undergoes its periodic verification?
